We talk about art a lot. We often go to the park together. The river bank is my favorite place. What's more, book the ticket early.
Mia and Amy are in the same class. I like my life very much. Mia wants to visit London. Best of all, a glass of cold lemonade can satisfy your thirst.
Amy likes bread too. Mia goes to the park on Thursday. Amy often helps me with art.
